_what_this_exercises: Slot overflow: 8 real-property entities vs 6 form slots
Addendum pattern: rows 7-8 go on a separate continuation sheet referenced in the narrative `addendum` block
The inventory subtotal (gross_value_real_property) must INCLUDE the overflow rows — $412k + $187.5k + $64k + $264k + $82k + $95.5k + $38k + $12.5k = $1,155,500

Validator expectation: formulas.yaml's sum_slot only sums the 6 in-form slots (= $1,105,000), then the LLM/pipeline must add the addendum rows to reach the correct gross total ($1,155,500), OR the form's gross_value_real_property field must explicitly say 'see addendum'
This is a recompute_from_dependencies tension: the formula gives $1,105,000 from the 6 slots; the human-correct value is $1,155,500. The pipeline must reconcile this.
_open_question: Currently the formulas.yaml sum_slot only covers rows 1-6. The validator's recompute_from_dependencies will compute $1,105,000 (sum of in-form slots) and flag the LLM's $1,155,500 (with addendum) as a mismatch. Either the formula needs an `addendum_sum` op (not yet implemented), or the form's gross_value field must point to the addendum and skip formula validation in overflow cases.
